### Navigation Summary:
- **Core Views**: Login, Inbox, Closed Tasks, and Settings are fully interconnected.
- **Detail Flows**: Back buttons and tab navigation across Services, Huawei xPON, History, Secondary, and DSLAM views are now operational.
- **Utility Modals**: Buttons for reporting, contacts, maps, and Wi-Fi configuration correctly trigger their respective modals, with all dismiss actions (Cancel/Backdrop) returning to the main task details.

The visual design, brand color palette, and Russian localization have been strictly preserved throughout the process. You can now test the complete, end-to-end interactive journey in the prototype preview.
